page.content:
The blue-brand weekly that launched in 1999.

How Friday Night SmackDown connects

  • Topic: WWE — SmackDown is WWE's blue-brand weekly show.
  • Character: Roman Reigns — The Bloodline's title era was centered on Friday Night SmackDown.

What is Friday Night SmackDown?

SmackDown began as WWE's Thursday, later Friday, counterpart to Raw and became the television home of The Bloodline's championship era.

Key threads lead to WWE and Roman Reigns.
